record.body: Find why test_prefix_a_popup_switches_status_tabs_filters_copies_a_slug_and_opens_a_commit_view fails on the GitHub runner about one run in four. On tmux 3.4 the Done tab shows a truncated task column (`titl`). Local tmux 3.5a passes. The test-tmux job reruns failures twice, which hides it. Check tmux popup sizing and plain_terminal in tests/helpers.py, then drop --reruns 2.
record.subject: tmux-popup-runner-flake
